roles.friendly.sentry: Reliable generalist; ordinary armor and LOS impede it.
roles.friendly.rotary: Heat+4/shot; at 100 overheats 3 s; lockout/cooling resolution in; cool 15/sec while not firing. Ground enemies hit 3 times/2 s receive 15% slow 2 s.
roles.friendly.breaker_cannon: 50% penetration; too slow for scattered runners.
roles.friendly.skyguard: Optional ground shot 36 damage, R 6, interval 1 s if no air target.
roles.friendly.arc_spire: Chain to 3 additional detected targets within 2.5 GU:65%, 45%, 30% base damage; no repeated target.
roles.friendly.mortar_nest: Predict position at launch, no in-flight tracking; misses mobile scattered threats.
roles.friendly.lance_array: Continuous lock ramps+10% DPS/sec to+50%; target change resets; beam LOS.
roles.friendly.nullifier: Detection 8; on hit suppress shield regeneration/healing 50% and hostile buff output 25% for 3 s; max 1 nullifier debuff.
roles.friendly.rifle_squad: 3 visual troopers; output 45 DPS at full health.
roles.friendly.heavy_squad: 2 heavy troopers; 3 hits/2 s cause 20% slow 2 s.
roles.friendly.combat_engineers: Two engineers; prioritize repair over weapon; can rearm traps:1 charge/6 s, 8 rearms per siege; consume no campaign currency during combat.
roles.friendly.field_medics: 2 medics; heal biological allies including Warden, not Core; idle weapon only.
roles.friendly.interceptor_drones: 2 visual drones as one asset; air movement, cannot occupy other air body center.
roles.friendly.aegis_walkers: Shield reserve 800 (omnidirectional personal pool); protects allies within 2.5 GU against direct shots, 20% damage redirected to its shield; recharges 20/s after 4 s undamaged.
roles.friendly.repair_node: Repair 25 I/s to one detected mechanical ally; Core half output; LOS; no wreck restoration.
roles.friendly.medical_station: Heal 30 H/s to one biological ally; Warden eligible.
roles.friendly.detection_relay: Reveal stealth; force surfaced Mole within 6 GU for 3 s, pulse every 6 s.
roles.friendly.shield_projector: Up to four eligible allies including Core receive 250-point slots from shared reserve 1000; allocation/absorption follows; replenish 25/s after 4 s no reserve damage; multiple projectors strongest only.
roles.friendly.ammunition_fabricator: Nearby Sentry/Rotary/Rifle/Heavy attack interval ×0.90 and Rotary cooling+20%; nonstacking. No ammunition inventory/currency.
roles.friendly.tactical_uplink: Allies decision interval ×0.80, accuracy+0.05 capped 1, detect memory+1 s; nonstacking.
roles.friendly.power_relay: Support R 4 extends buff/repair/heal range+0.75 GU strongest only; not tower weapons or other Relays.
roles.friendly.barracks: Deployment anchor for owned ground units; friendly R 4 damage Reduction 10%; heals biological 10 H/s outside engagement after 5 s; no recruitment spawn in battle.
roles.friendly.drone_bay: Anchor for owned drones; repairs one air mechanical 20 I/s, R 4; no spawning.
roles.friendly.command_node: Relay R 6+25% friendly perception radius and+1 s detected memory; allows secondary anchor per unit and automated sector fallback; no extra Command Capacity.
roles.friendly.proximity_mine: Ground within 1 GU triggers; 300 blast, AoE 1.5; 0.3 s warning before detonation; single use.
roles.friendly.slow_field: Ground radius 2; 35% slow while inside and 0.5 s after exit.
roles.friendly.arc_plate: Ground radius 1.5; 80 arc to 3 nearest targets; recharge 4 s; 20% slow 2 s.
roles.friendly.incendiary_vent: Ground within 1.5; cone 3 long, 90°; 40 DPS for 3 s plus 1 burn stack 10 DPS 4 s; recharge 6 s.
roles.friendly.armor_shredding_charge: Ground trigger within 1 GU: 100 blast in a 2 GU radius and 30 flat armor shred for 8 seconds. Two permanent charges; recharge 3 seconds.
roles.friendly.gravity_snare: B within 2; root 2 s ordinary/0.5 s boss, then 25% slow 3 s; air remains airborne; recharge 8 s.
roles.friendly.decoy_beacon: Ground detected within 4; activate hologram 10 s; enemy target utility+30 for beacon within 6, not compulsory boss taunt; recharge 15 s.
roles.friendly.collapse_charge: Ground within 1.2; telegraph 1 s; 500 blast radius 2.5, penetration 50%; terrain debris slows 20% for 8 s; no permanent holes.
roles.friendly.standard_barricade: Blocks both teams and direct fire; destructible; gives no cover bonus beyond physical block.
roles.friendly.reinforced_wall: Same block rules; durability comes from listed Integrity/armor; no undeclared incoming damage bonus.
roles.friendly.controlled_gate: Before 25 stays open if required route; after 25 policy:open, closed, allied passage. Passage opens on ally within 1 GU, holds 1 s; enemy can exploit opening; locked policy during battle.
roles.friendly.low_cover: traversable 0.8 speed multiplier; biological cover rules in; does not block shots.
roles.friendly.razor_field: Ground enemies take 15 DPS and 15% slow within cell; no friendly damage.
roles.friendly.anti_vehicle_obstacle: Blocks heavy ground radius ≥0.6; ordinary passes at 0.8 speed; LOS passes; geometry obstacle profile is explicit.
roles.friendly.elevated_firing_platform: One compatible 2×2 tower mounted; range+1 GU, low cover ignored; platform dies → tower loses 10% maxI and remains same ground footprint; no asset duplication.
roles.friendly.resonance_channel: Friendly ground within footprint S×1.15; enemy ground S×0.90; nonstacking; no music trigger.
